metadata.description: An SDLC where one required CI check is the gate, an adversarial code reviewer, and opt-in branch protection.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: The full single-repo SDLC: spec, plan, gate, ship, plus repo bootstrap (new), CI + deploy pipeline scaffolding (init, audit, secrets) with ci-pass as the one required enforcement check, and test-quality depth (test-gaps, test-critique, test-flake). Absorbs the former ci, scaffold, test, and deploy plugins. Pair with grumpy for review depth and sdlc-guardrails for opt-in main-branch protection.

plugins.name: grumpy
plugins.description: Adversarial code reviews from a principal engineer who's seen too many production incidents

plugins.name: sdlc-guardrails
plugins.description: Opt-in main-branch commit protection for the sdlc workflow (gate-chain enforcement lives in the sdlc plugin)
